cards.sentence_translation_zh: 晨间带教后，实习医生把乙酰胆碱写进了问题列表。

cards.meaning_en: midbrain, pons, and medulla connecting brain and cord
cards.context_sentence: The case note named the brain stem before describing what happened next.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The note first named midbrain, pons, and medulla connecting brain and cord, then said what followed.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 病历先写出脑干，再写接下来发生了什么。

cards.meaning_en: carrying impulses away from a center
cards.context_sentence: After examination the sign was documented as efferent.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Once the exam was done, the team wrote that the finding was carrying impulses away from a center.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 查体结束后，记录把该体征写成传出的。

cards.meaning_en: the lowest brainstem, continuous with the spinal cord
cards.context_sentence: The first chapter figure was a simple diagram of the medulla oblongata.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The opening figure was a plain diagram of the lowest brainstem, continuous with the spinal cord.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 该章第一张图就是延髓的简单示意图。

cards.meaning_en: carrying impulses toward a center
cards.context_sentence: The textbook warns not to write afferent unless the evidence actually fits.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The book says use this word only when the finding truly is carrying impulses toward a center.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 教材提醒：证据对得上时才能写传入的。

cards.meaning_en: one of the meninges covering brain or cord
cards.context_sentence: In class the tutor pointed to the meninx on the wall chart.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The tutor used the wall chart and pointed to one of the meninges covering brain or cord.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 课堂上，老师指着墙上的图讲解脑膜。

cards.meaning_en: relating to the rest-and-digest autonomic division
cards.context_sentence: The attending asked whether the process was truly parasympathetic in this patient.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The consultant checked that the process really was relating to the rest-and-digest autonomic division here.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 主治医师问：这个过程在该患者身上是否真的是副交感的。

cards.meaning_en: the bundle of lumbar and sacral roots below the cord
cards.context_sentence: The handover sheet kept the cauda equina on its own line.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The handover kept the bundle of lumbar and sacral roots below the cord on a separate line.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 交接单给马尾单独留了一行。

cards.meaning_en: the tough outer meninx; dura mater
cards.context_sentence: After history taking, the student wrote the dura under current problems.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Once the history was finished, the student listed the tough outer meninx; dura mater with the current problems.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 问完病史后，学生把硬膜写在目前问题下面。

cards.meaning_en: relating to the fight-or-flight autonomic division
cards.context_sentence: The quiz asked which finding should be called sympathetic.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The quiz wanted the finding that is honestly relating to the fight-or-flight autonomic division.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 测验问：哪个发现才该写成交感的。

cards.meaning_en: mater in dura/pia/arachnoid mater, a meningeal layer
cards.context_sentence: A labelled classroom slide showed the mater without extra commentary.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The teaching slide simply marked mater in dura/pia/arachnoid mater, a meningeal layer and left the rest for discussion.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 一张带标注的课堂幻灯只标出膜（脑脊膜），没有再加解释。

cards.meaning_en: the middle meningeal layer
cards.context_sentence: In the tutorial, each pair had to explain the arachnoid in one spoken sentence.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Tutorial pairs had to say the middle meningeal layer out loud in a single sentence.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 小组课上，每两人要用一句话口头解释蛛网膜。

cards.meaning_en: a cluster of nerve-cell bodies outside the CNS

cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The teaching meeting used the image so students could find a cluster of nerve-cell bodies outside the CNS.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 教学读片会上，用这张片子让学生找出神经节。

cards.meaning_en: the delicate inner meninx on the brain and cord surface
cards.context_sentence: Her revision list put the pia mater with two neighboring system terms.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The revision list grouped the delicate inner meninx on the brain and cord surface with two nearby system terms.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 她的复习表把软膜和两个邻近系统词放在一起。

cards.meaning_en: a network of nerves or vessels
cards.context_sentence: The chapter margin lists the plexus with other core classroom words.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The side note groups a network of nerves or vessels with the other must-know terms.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 章节页边把丛和其他课堂核心词列在一起。

cards.meaning_en: needle sampling of CSF in the lumbar sac
cards.context_sentence: A margin gloss repeats the lumbar puncture in smaller type beside the main paragraph.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The margin repeats needle sampling of CSF in the lumbar sac in smaller type next to the main paragraph.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 页边用小字在正文旁重复写出腰椎穿刺。

cards.meaning_en: the branching process that receives synaptic input
cards.context_sentence: The case stem named the dendrite before asking what to do next.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The exam-style stem first named the branching process that receives synaptic input, then asked for the next step.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 病例题干先写出树突，再问下一步怎么做。

cards.meaning_en: the charged state that underlies nerve action potentials
cards.context_sentence: The case note named the electrical charge before describing what happened next.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The note first named the charged state that underlies nerve action potentials, then said what followed.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 病历先写出电荷，再写接下来发生了什么。

cards.meaning_en: the long process that carries a nerve impulse away
cards.context_sentence: The admission note placed the axon among the early working problems.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The first ward note included the long process that carries a nerve impulse away in the early problem list.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 入院记录把轴突写进了初步问题。

cards.meaning_en: the insulating sheath around many axons
cards.context_sentence: The classroom quiz asked students to recognise the myelin from a short stem.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The quiz used a short stem and asked students to recognise the insulating sheath around many axons.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 随堂测验用一小段题干，让学生认出髓鞘质。

cards.meaning_en: the Schwann-cell sheath around a peripheral axon
cards.context_sentence: In the anatomy lab a pin marked the neurilemma on the demonstration specimen.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: A lab pin showed where the Schwann-cell sheath around a peripheral axon sat on the demonstration specimen.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 解剖实验室里，标本上的钉子标出了神经膜。

cards.meaning_en: the junction where one neuron signals another
cards.context_sentence: The printed handover sheet kept the synapse on the first line.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The paper handover put the junction where one neuron signals another at the top of the list.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 打印的交接单把突触放在第一行。

cards.meaning_en: CNS tissue rich in myelinated axons
cards.context_sentence: The wall chart boxed the white matter so students could find it quickly.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The wall chart put a box around CNS tissue rich in myelinated axons to make it easy to spot.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 墙上的图给白质加了框，方便学生快速找到。

cards.meaning_en: CNS tissue rich in cell bodies
cards.context_sentence: The handover sheet kept the gray matter on its own line.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The handover kept CNS tissue rich in cell bodies on a separate line.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 交接单给灰质单独留了一行。

cards.meaning_en: a chemical signal released at a synapse
cards.context_sentence: The intern added neurotransmitter to the problem list after morning teaching.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: After the teaching round, the intern listed a chemical signal released at a synapse among the problems.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 晨间带教后，实习医生把神经递质写进了问题列表。

cards.meaning_en: the supporting cells of the nervous system
cards.usage_note: 课堂构词：neuro-（神经） + glia-（胶质）。先用构词抓住大意，细节仍看课堂释义和病历写法。
cards.context_sentence: On the ward round the registrar paused so juniors could name the neuroglia.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: During rounds the senior stopped and asked the juniors to name the supporting cells of the nervous system.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 查房时，高年资住院医师停下来，让低年资医生说出神经胶质。

cards.meaning_en: a star-shaped glial cell of the CNS
cards.usage_note: 课堂构词：astro-（星形） + -cyte（细胞）。先用构词抓住大意，细节仍看课堂释义和病历写法。
cards.context_sentence: The lecture slide highlighted the astrocyte next to a simpler neighboring term.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The classroom slide put a star-shaped glial cell of the CNS beside a plainer nearby word.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 课堂幻灯把星形胶质细胞标在一个更浅的邻近词旁边。

cards.meaning_en: a tumor of glial cells
cards.usage_note: 课堂构词：gli-（胶质） + -oma（瘤）。先记这是肿物或增生，良性还是恶性不能只靠词尾。
cards.context_sentence: A one-paragraph case opened by naming the glioma before later findings.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The short case first named a tumor of glial cells, then listed what came next.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 短病例开头先写出胶质瘤，再写后面的发现。

cards.meaning_en: the resident immune cells of the CNS
cards.usage_note: 课堂构词：micro-（小） + glia-（胶质）。先用构词抓住大意，细节仍看课堂释义和病历写法。
cards.context_sentence: The textbook figure labels the microglia beside the neighboring tissue.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The printed figure marks the resident immune cells of the CNS next to the nearby tissue.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 教材插图把小胶质细胞标在邻近组织旁边。

cards.meaning_en: CNS cells that form myelin
cards.usage_note: 课堂构词：oligo-（少） + dendro-（突） + glia-（胶质）。先用构词抓住大意，细节仍看课堂释义和病历写法。
cards.context_sentence: In class the tutor pointed to the oligodendroglia on the wall chart.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The tutor used the wall chart and pointed to CNS cells that form myelin.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 课堂上，老师指着墙上的图讲解少突胶质细胞。

cards.meaning_en: the large paired hemispheres of the brain
cards.context_sentence: In the skills lab students had to identify the cerebrum on a model.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Lab practice asked students to find the large paired hemispheres of the brain on the model.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 技能实验室里，学生要在模型上认出大脑。

cards.meaning_en: a gyrus; a fold of the cerebral cortex
cards.context_sentence: The progress note mentioned the convolution in one plain line.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The ward note used one simple line to record a gyrus; a fold of the cerebral cortex.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 病程记录用一句平实的话写到了脑回。

cards.meaning_en: nerves and ganglia outside the brain and cord
cards.context_sentence: The lecture placed the peripheral nervous system next to related classroom structures.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The lecture sat nerves and ganglia outside the brain and cord beside related classroom structures.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 讲课把周围神经系统放在相关课堂结构旁边。

cards.meaning_en: the involuntary visceral motor system
cards.context_sentence: The case note named the autonomic nervous system before describing what happened next.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The note first named the involuntary visceral motor system, then said what followed.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 病历先写出自主神经系统，再写接下来发生了什么。

cards.meaning_en: the nerves supplying internal organs
cards.context_sentence: Students had to explain the visceral nervous system in one plain sentence of their own.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Each student had to say the nerves supplying internal organs in one ordinary sentence.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 学生要用自己的一句白话解释内脏神经系统。

cards.meaning_en: a shallow furrow on a bone or organ surface
cards.context_sentence: In the tutorial, each pair had to explain the groove in one spoken sentence.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: Tutorial pairs had to say a shallow furrow on a bone or organ surface out loud in a single sentence.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 小组课上，每两人要用一句话口头解释沟。

cards.meaning_en: a deeper cleft, as between cerebral hemispheres
cards.context_sentence: At the teaching conference the film was used to locate the fissure.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The teaching meeting used the image so students could find a deeper cleft, as between cerebral hemispheres.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 教学读片会上，用这张片子让学生找出裂。

cards.meaning_en: a groove between gyri of the cortex
cards.context_sentence: Night handover listed the sulcus before the overnight plan.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The night team named a groove between gyri of the cortex first, then said what to do overnight.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 夜班交接时先提到沟，再讲夜间计划。

cards.meaning_en: the diencephalic relay for sensory pathways to cortex
cards.context_sentence: The chapter margin lists the thalamus with other core classroom words.
cards.plain_english_paraphrase: The side note groups the diencephalic relay for sensory pathways to cortex with the other must-know terms.
cards.sentence_translation_zh: 章节页边把丘脑和其他课堂核心词列在一起。
